changes: Queue JARVIS V8.5 portable feature pack for discovery; no core replacement in this release.

features.name: Intent and action routing
features.description: Interpret open, search, memory, and action requests with confirmation gates.

features.name: OpenSSH / SFTP file access
features.description: Optional Windows OpenSSH Server setup guidance for direct SSH/SFTP file transfer between trusted PCs; system service, firewall, and remote-access changes require explicit approval.

features.name: Universal Command Router
features.description: Normalizes supported natural-language phrasing and routes only registered commands.

features.name: System Intelligence
features.description: Read-only host, CPU, memory, disk, battery, and uptime summary; metrics may be platform-dependent.

features.name: Smart App Launcher
features.description: Launch allowlisted applications and websites; no arbitrary shell command execution.

features.name: Persistent Memory
features.description: Local user-approved preferences stored in a dedicated data file; supports view and forget.

features.name: Offline Brain
features.description: Explicit offline fallback responses; general local-model reasoning requires a separately configured model.

features.name: File Intelligence
features.description: Search selected user folders and report paths; no automatic file edits, deletion, or uploads.

features.name: Focus Mode
features.description: Local countdown timer and focus session commands.

features.name: Network Watch
features.description: Basic DNS/connectivity check only; not a security scanner.

features.name: Hardware Simulator
features.description: Virtual LED/device state for demos; no physical GPIO access.

features.name: Portable Profile
features.description: Detects current host and app location without uploading device identity.
